MODEL_SCRIPTS[qwen25]="scripts/qwen25_7b_annotate.py"
MODEL_SCRIPTS[mistral7b]="scripts/mistral7b_annotate.py"
MODEL_SCRIPTS[gemma2]="scripts/gemma2_9b_annotate.py"

declare -A MODEL_GPUS
MODEL_GPUS[llama31]=0
MODEL_GPUS[qwen25]=1
MODEL_GPUS[mistral7b]=2
MODEL_GPUS[gemma2]=3

declare -A LAUNCHED
declare -A PIDS

check_model_ready() {
    local name=$1
    local path=${MODEL_PATHS[$name]}
    if [ -f "${path}/config.json" ] && ls ${path}/*.safetensors >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        local temp_dir="/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/._____temp"
        local ns=$(echo $path | sed "s|/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/||")
        if [ -d "${temp_dir}/${ns}" ]; then
            local temp_count=$(find "${temp_dir}/${ns}" -name "*.safetensors" -o -name "*.pth" 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
            if [ "$temp_count" -gt 0 ]; then
                return 1
            fi
        fi
        return 0
    fi
    return 1
}

echo "Auto-launcher started at $(date)" | tee $LOGDIR/launcher.log

while true; do
    all_done=true
    for name in llama31 qwen25 mistral7b gemma2; do
        if [ "${LAUNCHED[$name]}" = "1" ]; then
            continue
        fi
        all_done=false
        if check_model_ready $name; then
            gpu=${MODEL_GPUS[$name]}
            script=${MODEL_SCRIPTS[$name]}
            model_path=${MODEL_PATHS[$name]}
            echo "$(date): LAUNCHING $name on GPU $gpu with $model_path" | tee -a $LOGDIR/launcher.log
            CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$gpu python3 $script --z-definition balanced --model-path "$model_path" --device cuda:0 > $LOGDIR/log_${name}.txt 2>&1 &
            PIDS[$name]=$!
            LAUNCHED[$name]=1
            echo "$(date): $name PID=${PIDS[$name]}" | tee -a $LOGDIR/launcher.log
        fi
    done

    if $all_done; then
        echo "$(date): All 4 models launched. Waiting for completion..." | tee -a $LOGDIR/launcher.log
        break
    fi
    sleep 30
done

for name in llama31 qwen25 mistral7b gemma2; do
    pid=${PIDS[$name]}
    if [ -n "$pid" ]; then
        wait $pid
        exit_code=$?
        echo "$(date): $name (PID $pid) finished with exit code $exit_code" | tee -a $LOGDIR/launcher.log
    fi
done

echo "$(date): ALL INFERENCE COMPLETE" | tee -a $LOGDIR/launcher.log

check_model_ready() {
    local name=$1
    local path=${MODEL_PATHS[$name]}
    if [ -f "${path}/config.json" ] && ls ${path}/*.safetensors >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        # Verify all shards present by checking index file
        if [ -f "${path}/model.safetensors.index.json" ]; then
            local expected=$(grep -o '"model-[^"]*safetensors"' "${path}/model.safetensors.index.json" | sort -u | wc -l)
            local actual=$(ls ${path}/model-*.safetensors 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
            if [ "$expected" -gt 0 ] && [ "$actual" -lt "$expected" ]; then
                return 1
            fi
        fi
        local temp_dir="/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/._____temp"
        local ns=$(echo $path | sed "s|/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/||" | sed "s|___|.|g")
        if [ -d "${temp_dir}/${ns}" ]; then
            local temp_count=$(find "${temp_dir}/${ns}" -name "*.safetensors" -o -name "*.pth" 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
            if [ "$temp_count" -gt 0 ]; then
                return 1
            fi
        fi
        # Check HF download temp (.incomplete files)
        if [ -d "${path}/.cache/huggingface/download" ]; then
            local hf_temp=$(find "${path}/.cache/huggingface/download" -name "*.incomplete" 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
            if [ "$hf_temp" -gt 0 ]; then
                return 1
            fi
        fi
        return 0
    fi
    return 1
}

source /etc/network_turbo; export PATH=/root/miniconda3/bin:$PATH HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1 REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt; kill 7064 6517 6615 8618 2>/dev/null; echo "Killed all parallel downloads"; cat > /root/work/sequential_download.py << 'PYEOF'
import time, os, sys

def download_model(name, model_id, ignore=None):
    from modelscope import snapshot_download
    print(f"\n{'='*60}", flush=True)
    print(f"[{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] Starting {name}: {model_id}", flush=True)
    start = time.time()
    kwargs = dict(cache_dir='/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache')
    if ignore:
        kwargs['ignore_file_pattern'] = ignore
    path = snapshot_download(model_id, **kwargs)
    elapsed = time.time() - start
    print(f"[{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] DONE {name}: {path} ({elapsed/60:.1f} min)", flush=True)
    return path

models = [
    ("Qwen", "Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct", None),
    ("Gemma", "AI-ModelScope/gemma-2-9b-it", None),
    ("Llama", "LLM-Research/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct", ["original/*", "*.pth"]),
    ("Mistral", "LLM-Research/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3", None),
]

print(f"[{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] Sequential download starting (4 models)...", flush=True)
for name, model_id, ignore in models:
    try:
        download_model(name, model_id, ignore)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] FAILED {name}: {e}", flush=True)
print(f"\n[{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] ALL DOWNLOADS COMPLETE", flush=True)
PYEOF
echo "Script created"; nohup python3 /root/work/sequential_download.py > /root/work/results/download_sequential.txt 2>&1 & echo "Sequential download PID: $!"
